source.entry: 2026-09-17 — acme-portal-sample-014 retrospective: a reported test failure is reproduced before anything is edited
source.quote: Applies to: worker prompt, and the orchestrator's bead-writing rules (a bead created from a reported failure states the exact command and requires the reproduction step before any edit).

input: [repo: webapp] On my machine `pnpm e2e -- checkout` fails on dev at e2e/specs/checkout.spec.ts:41 with "Timed out 10000ms waiting for locator('#pay-button')". It passed yesterday. Please fix it.

reply.verification: runs verify command `pnpm lint` in the bead's worktree after the worker ends

reply.title: Fix the checkout e2e timeout on #pay-button

assertions.line: The task description requires the worker to run the reported command and reproduce the failure before editing anything.
